## c1 · Toolkit Core (shared by i1–i4)
Input: raw SerpApi searches + the Listings history. Output: listing rows, one row per keyword, one row per market.

- Groups variations of one product (shared review count) so reviews are counted once
- Score 0-100 from five parts, breakdown written out
- Stability: compares with the previous run of the same keyword
- Variants: keywords sharing 70%+ of sales are one market

No AI. No API calls. Same input always gives the same output.
